description: This Java class 'ModelServiceReader' reads and parses XML service definitions for the OFBiz framework, creating in-memory models of services with their parameters, permissions, notifications, and other configurations.

classes.name: ModelServiceReader
classes.description: A class that reads XML service definitions and constructs ModelService objects for the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getModelServiceMap
methods.description: Static method to create a map of service names to ModelService objects from a URL or ResourceHandler.

methods.name: getModelServices
methods.description: Reads the XML document and constructs ModelService objects for each service element.

methods.name: createModelService
methods.description: Creates a ModelService object from an XML element representing a service.

methods.name: getCDATADef
methods.description: Extracts CDATA content from a specified XML tag within an element.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates default and custom notifications for a service based on XML configuration.

methods.name: createServicePermission
methods.description: Creates a permission object for a service from an XML element.

methods.name: createAloneServicePermission
methods.description: Creates a permission for the service if specified in XML.

methods.name: createPermGroups
methods.description: Creates permission groups for a service based on XML configuration.

methods.name: createGroupPermissions
methods.description: Creates individual permissions within a permission group.

methods.name: createGroupDefs
methods.description: Creates internal group definitions for a service.

methods.name: createImplDefs
methods.description: Adds implementation service references to a service.

methods.name: createAutoAttrDefs
methods.description: Creates auto-attribute parameters based on entity fields.

methods.name: createAutoAttrDef
methods.description: Creates a single auto-attribute parameter from XML configuration.

methods.name: createAttrDefs
methods.description: Creates attribute parameters for the service, including default ones.

methods.name: createAttrDef
methods.description: Creates a parameter object from an attribute XML element.

methods.name: createOverrideDefs
methods.description: Overrides parameters in the service with new definitions.

methods.name: createDeprecated
methods.description: Marks a service as deprecated if specified.

methods.name: addValidators
methods.description: Adds validation rules to a parameter based on XML.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Loads an XML document from a URL.
